items.description: Map the repository modules, artifacts, and active-vs-legacy boundaries.
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/repo_map.md` listing every major file/module under the repo root, `.archivara/`, `results/`, and `790a8891-d60d-46f1-8aef-84f720d59562_aristotle/`; mark each as active, helper, generated, or legacy; document import/execution connections; explicitly state that root `solution.py` and `test_solution.py` are the active execution path.

items.description: Align the research direction with the existing swarm briefs before any implementation.
items.acceptance_criteria: Read `results/swarm/director_brief.md`, `results/swarm/hypotheses.json`, and `results/swarm/tool_plan.md`; write `results/swarm/implementation_alignment.md` naming the champion, backup, and reserve lanes; record why the next implementation starts with the four-vertex lift and not legacy stochastic search or Paley repackaging.

items.description: Repair and extend the literature snapshot using targeted web search instead of restarting from zero.
items.acceptance_criteria: Update `results/literature/literature_snapshot.json` in place by extending the existing snapshot; use web search plus `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py` to add at least 10 problem-local sources and at least 2 relevant code or benchmark artifacts on triangular/book Ramsey graphs, exact witnesses, SAT/IP search, or circulant/block constructions; preserve prior entries with drift notes rather than deleting history.

items.description: Create the bibliography and keep the prior-art gap log current.
items.acceptance_criteria: `sources.bib` exists at repo root with at least 10 relevant BibTeX entries drawn from consulted sources; `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` is updated after the literature pass and after each major experimental milestone with differentiation notes, evidence artifacts, and pivot decisions for the named watchlist papers plus at least 3 book-Ramsey-local papers.

items.description: Run a Codex multi-agent Phase 1 literature and concept-tree synthesis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate a bounded Phase 1 pass using `explorer`, `citation_auditor`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator`; write `results/literature/prior_art_review.md`; create at least 3 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_1_problem/`; include an explicit note comparing the planned direction against `String Graph Obstacles of High Girth and of Bounded Degree (2025)`, `Quantum Based Grover's Algorithm and Graph Coloring in Unstructured Searches for Bit String Validation (2025)`, `FSG: Fast String Graph Construction for De Novo Assembly (2016)`, and `A 1.9999-Approximation Algorithm for Vertex Cover on String Graphs (2024)`.

items.description: Reproduce the deterministic baseline and freeze the starting coverage table.
items.acceptance_criteria: Run `python -m unittest -v test_solution.py` and `python solution.py --verify-supported --limit 100`; store the commands, dates, and outputs in `results/verification/baseline_regression.md`; record the baseline support table over `n<=100`, including the current `42 supported / 58 unsupported` split if unchanged.

items.description: Build a machine-readable witness provenance map.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/witness_provenance.json` mapping every `n` in `1..100` to one of `small_exact`, `exact_graph6`, `exact_two_block`, `prime_power_family`, or `unsupported`; include source references for each exact witness block and a summary count by category.

items.description: Audit graph6 and exact-witness source provenance.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/verification/witness_source_audit.md` tracing each embedded graph6 string and the `n=22` exact two-block witness to a paper, appendix, benchmark page, or repository artifact; unresolved provenance entries must be listed explicitly rather than assumed.

items.description: Mine baseline structural features from the verified witness bank.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/analysis/exact_witness_features.json` covering all supported exact witnesses through `n=22`; include degree multisets, saturated pair counts, pair-slack histograms, and coarse orbit or symmetry summaries suitable for the four-vertex-lift and composite-orbit hypotheses.

items.description: Run a Codex multi-agent Phase 2 baseline audit and concept-tree expansion.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate a bounded Phase 2 pass using `worker`, `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator`; write `results/verification/baseline_audit.md` separating root-baseline claims from legacy-archive behavior; create at least 3 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_2_baseline/` summarizing baseline metrics, provenance controls, and archive-contamination risks.

items.description: Formalize the champion four-vertex-lift research plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/research/four_vertex_lift_spec.md` defining the fixed-old-graph setting, variables for old-new and new-new incidences, known-step recovery targets `20->21` and `21->22`, the frontier target `22->23`, the verifier-aligned objective, runtime budget, and the kill switch from `results/swarm/director_brief.md`.

items.description: Formalize the backup exact pair-slack repair plan.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/research/pair_slack_repair_spec.md` defining the exact per-pair slack objective, move scoring, comparison metrics, and benchmark set `{22,24,50}`; the spec must explicitly say BP-style or other bridge ideas are disallowed until the exact-slack baseline shows a verifier-aligned win.

items.description: Gate the reserve composite-order orbit-template lane with evidence rather than intuition.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/research/composite_orbit_gate.md` deciding whether `composite_orbit_templates` stays reserved; the decision must cite `results/analysis/exact_witness_features.json` and state the minimum low-orbit or autocorrelation evidence required before any implementation budget is spent.

items.description: Expand the concept tree for core hypotheses and negative-space alternatives.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create at least 6 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_3_hypotheses/`, covering the four-vertex lift, pair-slack repair, composite-order orbit templates, BP repair, SDP seeding, and DSL/program-synthesis ideas; each card must include why it is different, the easiest falsifier, and the overlap risk with known work.

items.description: Run a Codex multi-agent Phase 3 hypothesis ranking and novelty check.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate a bounded Phase 3 pass using `research_director`, `hypothesis_scout`, `falsifier`, `novelty_checker`, and `integrator`; write `results/research/hypothesis_ranking.md` ranking champion, backup, and reserve lanes; update `results/literature/prior_art_gap.md` with explicit differentiation or pivot notes against the named watchlist papers and at least 2 problem-local book-Ramsey or SAT/IP sources.

items.description: Execute known-step recovery experiments for the four-vertex lift.
items.acceptance_criteria: Run bounded recovery experiments for `20->21` and `21->22` using the restricted completion model; store commands, seeds if any, runtime, verifier-call counts, and outcomes in `results/experiments/four_vertex_lift_known_steps.md`; if both known-step recoveries fail reproducibly, mark the champion lane killed.

items.description: Attempt the first frontier case only after known-step recovery is evaluated.
items.acceptance_criteria: If item_016 passes its kill switch, run a bounded `22->23` experiment and record the result in `results/experiments/four_vertex_lift_frontier.md`; include success or failure status, best slack margin, runtime, and whether the outcome changes the supported frontier.

items.description: Benchmark the exact pair-slack repair baseline on the hard cases.
items.acceptance_criteria: Run the backup lane on `n=22`, `n=24`, and `n=50`; compare it against the archived surrogate-objective search or a documented equivalent baseline using verifier calls, best achieved slack margin, reproducibility, and runtime; record the comparison in `results/experiments/pair_slack_benchmark.md`.

items.description: Maintain reproducible experiment manifests and monitoring logs.
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/experiments/experiment_manifest.json` describing each experiment, input set, command, time budget, and artifact outputs; for any run longer than 5 minutes, save monitoring notes or checkpoints sufficient for rerun or interruption recovery.

items.description: Run a Codex multi-agent Phase 4 experiment synthesis and benchmark audit.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate a bounded Phase 4 pass using `worker`, `monitor`, `benchmark_auditor`, `falsifier`, and `integrator`; write or update `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`; create at least 3 concept cards under `results/concept_evolve/tree/phase_4_results/` capturing successful patterns, killed directions, and frontier blockers.

items.description: Quantify coverage change and audit claims against the baseline.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/verification/coverage_delta.md` comparing the latest solver coverage against the Phase 2 baseline over `n<=100`; explicitly report whether the solver is still partial, and if the `42 supported / 58 unsupported` baseline changed, document the exact delta by `n`.

items.description: Perform a final novelty audit against named prior work and repaired local sources.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/verification/novelty_report.md` comparing the final planned or implemented method against `String Graph Obstacles of High Girth and of Bounded Degree (2025)`, `Quantum Based Grover's Algorithm and Graph Coloring in Unstructured Searches for Bit String Validation (2025)`, `FSG: Fast String Graph Construction for De Novo Assembly (2016)`, `A 1.9999-Approximation Algorithm for Vertex Cover on String Graphs (2024)`, and at least 3 problem-local book-Ramsey, exact-witness, or SAT/IP sources; the report must say whether each overlap is real, superficial retrieval drift, or a pivot trigger.

items.description: Audit citations and freeze the bibliography.
items.acceptance_criteria: Run a citation pass over all literature, experiment, and final-report artifacts; `sources.bib` must contain at least 10 relevant papers plus any consulted code or benchmark entries; write `results/verification/citation_audit.md` listing every unsupported claim or missing citation that must be fixed before publication.

items.description: Produce the final analysis and documentation package without overclaiming.
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/final_report.md` summarizing the baseline, chosen direction, experiments, results, limitations, and next steps; it must explicitly distinguish the active root artifact from the legacy archive and must not claim a full all-`n` solution unless Phase 4 evidence actually proves that.

items.description: Run a Codex multi-agent final verification bundle and synthesis.
items.acceptance_criteria: Delegate a bounded Phase 5 pass using `novelty_checker`, `citation_auditor`, `benchmark_auditor`, and `integrator`; ensure `results/verification/novelty_report.md`, `results/verification/citation_audit.md`, `results/verification/benchmark_report.md`, and `results/verification/verification_summary.md` all exist and cross-reference one another; `results/verification/verification_summary.md` must state the final claim language approved for external use.
